principle.id: Nilai menilai proses, bukan untung atau rugi. Proses yang benar tetap bernilai baik walaupun kena SL; proses yang salah tidak mendapat nilai tambahan karena kebetulan untung.
principle.en: The score judges the process, never the profit or loss. A sound process still scores well when it hits the SL; a poor one earns nothing extra for a lucky profit.

risk.measure: risk_pct = |entry − SL| in pips × pip value per lot (USD) × lot ÷ balance × 100

volatility_part.measure: sl_atr = |entry − SL| ÷ ATR(14) at Start (key: numbers.atr14_pips)

bonus.when: SL beyond numbers.invalidation_level (or no level given)

reasons.rule: 6 × (valid reasons chosen ÷ reasons chosen); 0 with no reason

cases.case: ran to SL, TP or the window's auto-close
manual close with a valid close reason (structure_broken, news_ahead, target_area)
manual close before the target without a valid reason (small_profit, bored)
panic close near the SL without a new signal (fear)

scenario_no_trade.rule: When decision.ideal is no_trade the whole score is decision and reasons.

pending_unfilled.rule: A pending order that never fills is scored on the decision only: decision points × 5 (out of 100); lot, SL and TP aren't scored.

mcq_complex.rule: Per option: +1 ÷ k for each right option chosen, −1 ÷ k for each wrong option chosen (k = number of right options); floor 0, max 1.

report.id: Hasil akhir berupa umpan balik per aspek (risiko, SL, TP/R:R, keputusan, manajemen posisi) dan level Learn 101 yang perlu diulang, dihitung dari soal PG yang salah per level. Tanpa peringkat dan tanpa perbandingan antar pengguna.
report.en: The result is feedback per aspect (risk, SL, TP/R:R, decision, position management) and the Learn 101 levels to revisit, from the wrong answers per level. No ranking and no comparison between users.

decision.id: Struktur memang turun, tetapi ATR M15 beberapa kali lipat dari biasanya dan harga melompat-lompat. SL yang masuk akal terhadap volatilitas ini menuntut lot sangat kecil, sementara spread dan slippage bisa membengkak. Level 3 dan 5 sama-sama menyebut volatilitas ekstrem sebagai kondisi untuk menahan diri. NO TRADE adalah pilihan yang tepat.
decision.en: The structure is falling, but the M15 ATR is several times its normal size and price is jumping around. An SL that respects this volatility needs a tiny lot, while spreads and slippage can balloon. Levels 3 and 5 both name extreme volatility as a time to hold back. NO TRADE is the right call.

decision.id: Batas rugi harian sudah terlewati dan dorongan untuk "mengembalikan" adalah tanda revenge trading (Level 6). Apa pun bentuk chart-nya, keputusan yang benar adalah berhenti untuk hari ini, menutup platform, dan menulis jurnal. Memilih alasan "ingin menutup kerugian" justru menunjukkan pemicu yang harus dihindari.
decision.en: The daily loss limit has been passed and the urge to "win it back" is a sign of revenge trading (Level 6). Whatever the chart looks like, the right decision is to stop for today, close the platform and write in the journal. Picking "I want to win back the losses" as a reason shows exactly the trigger to avoid.

explanation.id: Pembulatan ke atas membuat kerugian pada SL lebih besar dari risiko yang ditetapkan.
explanation.en: Rounding up makes the loss at the SL bigger than the risk you set.

explanation.id: TR = maks(H − L, |H − close sebelumnya|, |L − close sebelumnya|) = maks(20, 45, 25) = 45 pip.
explanation.en: TR = max(H − L, |H − previous close|, |L − previous close|) = max(20, 45, 25) = 45 pips.

explanation.id: Pola baru sah setelah close menembus garis kunci; sebelum itu masih hipotesis.
explanation.en: A pattern is only valid once a close breaks the key line; before that it's a hypothesis.

explanation.id: Saat AS musim dingin, 14.00 New York = 02.00 WIB keesokan harinya; saat musim panas 01.00 WIB.
explanation.en: During US winter time, 14:00 New York = 02:00 WIB the next day; in summer it's 01:00 WIB.

explanation.id: Actual adalah angka baru, previous angka lama, forecast adalah konsensus yang sudah "masuk harga".
explanation.en: Actual is the new number, previous the old one, and forecast the consensus that's already "in the price".

explanation.id: Konsep Peter Gollwitzer (1999): pemicu dan respons yang konkret membuat tindakan berjalan hampir otomatis.
explanation.en: Peter Gollwitzer's concept (1999): a concrete trigger and response make the action run almost automatically.

explanation.id: Dalam simulasi materi, strategi yang sebenarnya untung masih sekitar 13% berpeluang negatif setelah 20 transaksi.
explanation.en: In the lesson's simulation, a strategy that really wins still has about a 13% chance of being negative after 20 trades.
